result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 6 against AC-4.4 and AC-4.5 across the cutover surfaces named by the story and tech design: async readiness, smart compact, thread-view build/materialization, PI-target output, workbench inspection/reporting, and the long-thread runtime E2E proof. I also ran the configured story and epic gates and audited remaining placeholder-era production and test paths.

newFindings.title: The configured story gate is not trustworthy: standalone `npm run verify` fails while `npm run verify-all` passes
newFindings.evidence: A standalone rerun of `npm run verify` failed and `/tmp/story6-verify.log` ends with `tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts:1236-1304` failing because `after.thread.status.tokenCounting?.status` was `undefined` instead of `string` at line 1303. A separate full run of `npm run verify-all` exited 0 and `/tmp/story6-verify-all.log` shows both the service suite and E2E suite passing. That fail/pass split makes TC-6.4a gate truth untrusted for this story handoff.

newFindings.title: Compaction reporting still reads placeholder-era lower-band state instead of semantic artifacts
newFindings.evidence: `buildCompactionAuditReport()` still feeds `resolveChunkPlaceholderTokenAccounting(...)` and `artifact: chunk.placeholders?.[bandType]` into the lower-band audit path (`src/workbench/services/compaction-report-service.ts:289-305`). `inspectLowerBandFreshness()` also expects placeholder-era fields such as `generatedFromComponentSmooth`, `smoothSourceRevision`, and `smoothSourceTokenCount` (`src/workbench/services/compaction-report-service.ts:139-174`), which canonical semantic `chunk.lowerBand` artifacts do not carry. The happy-path report fixture is explicitly seeded with canonical closed chunks via `seedDeterministicRebuildThreadWithOptions(..., { canonicalClosedChunks: true })` (`tests/workbench/compaction-report-service.test.ts:9-10`), yet the test still expects both selected chunks to report `lowerBandFreshness.status: "blocked_or_stale"` (`tests/workbench/compaction-report-service.test.ts:236-275`). That leaves the operator audit surface on a placeholder-era contract even for real semantic lower-band output.

newFindings.title: Runtime readiness and inspection APIs still preserve the placeholder compatibility shim
newFindings.evidence: The async readiness contract still exposes placeholder-era names and blocker codes: `CHUNK_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING`, `placeholdersReady`, and `requiredPlaceholderBands` remain part of `AsyncThreadStatus` / `PrepareAsyncThreadInput` / `PrepareAsyncThreadResult` (`src/thread/async-thread/domain/async-thread-status.ts:5-45`). `smart-compact` still passes `requiredPlaceholderBands` into prepare-mode runtime flow (`src/commands/smart-compact.ts:363-372`), `prepareAsyncThread()` still derives `placeholdersReady` from `CHUNK_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING` while describing semantic lower-band output (`src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:880-921`), and workbench inspection still emits `CHUNK_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING` for missing semantic lower-band artifacts (`src/workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:195-203`). Tests continue codifying that shim in the cutover suite (`tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts:756-790`, `tests/commands/smart-compact.test.ts:709-864`, `tests/context-workbench/workbench-query-service.test.ts:737-741`). Story 6 explicitly forbids preserving a runtime compatibility shim for placeholder output, but the normal runtime/reporting contract still speaks in placeholder terms.

newFindings.title: The required long-thread proof still blesses placeholder-era setup and can pass without enforcing the success path
newFindings.evidence: The shared long-thread prep helper still imports and runs the placeholder generator: `tests/thread-view/real-long-thread-fixture-prep.ts:8` imports `ensurePlaceholderArtifacts`, and lines 331-337 regenerate placeholder artifacts for closed chunks. The focused prep test then asserts `prepared.regeneratedPlaceholderChunkIds.length > 0` (`tests/thread-view/real-long-thread-fixture-prep.test.ts:52-74`). On the Story 5/6 runtime proof itself, `tests/context-steward/long-thread-real-pi-execution.e2e.test.ts:749-760` treats a `legacy_placeholder_chunk_state` blocked result as an acceptable early return, so the test can still pass without requiring the generated-rollout success path that later checks placeholder-free output at lines 788-799. That means TC-4.4a / TC-4.5b are not fully enforced by the E2E proof even though the current `verify-all` run happened to pass.

productionPathFindings: Compaction audit reporting still reads `chunk.placeholders` and placeholder-era freshness fields instead of semantic `chunk.lowerBand` artifacts (`src/workbench/services/compaction-report-service.ts:139-174,289-305`).

Prepare/inspection contracts still expose `requiredPlaceholderBands`, `placeholdersReady`, and `CHUNK_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING` for semantic lower-band output (`src/thread/async-thread/domain/async-thread-status.ts:5-45`, `src/commands/smart-compact.ts:363-372`, `src/workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:195-203`).
additionalObservations: I found no remaining production import of `placeholder-artifact-service` under `src/` outside the legacy module itself; the explicit surviving import is test-only in `tests/thread-view/real-long-thread-fixture-prep.ts`, which supports TC-4.5a but not the test-cutover requirement.

`src/thread-view/targets/pi/pi-thread-view-builder.ts` and `tests/thread-view/pi-thread-view-builder.test.ts` are correctly cut over: legacy placeholder chunks are blocked and semantic lower-band PI output is emitted with `placeholderExplicit: false`.

The full epic gate is real and non-empty in this checkout: `/tmp/story6-verify-all.log` shows the service suite, the general E2E suite, and the long-thread PI runtime E2E all executed. The blocker is that the standalone story gate is inconsistent and the placeholder-era cutover is still incomplete on reporting/runtime-contract/test-proof surfaces.
